page_title: ATM 3-0 MAL | Atletico Madrid v Mallorca 25/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+3' Atl. Madrid take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

90+3' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Atl. Madrid. Koke (Atl. Madrid) cuts inside his marker and unleashes a rocket of a shot from inside the box. The ball flies towards the top right corner, but it's kept out by magnificent save from Leo Roman.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Samu Costa leaves the pitch and Javier Llabres (Mallorca) comes on.

87' 3 - 0 An amazing individual effort from Thiago Almada (Atl. Madrid) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball into the roof of the net and makes it 3:0. Leo Roman was helpless.
87' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Atl. Madrid.
86' Jose Sanchez shows a yellow card to David Lopez (Mallorca) for his blatant foul.
84' The statistic for corner kicks – 8:3.
79' Diego Simeone prepares a substitution. Giuliano Simeone is replaced by Koke (Atl. Madrid).

78' Martin Valjent (Mallorca) wastes a huge opportunity! He receives a precise cross inside the penalty area and releases a quick shot that sails towards the bottom left corner. His effort, however, lacks power and the goalkeeper dives to make a stunning save.
78' Mallorca have been awarded a corner kick.
75' David Lopez (Mallorca) attempts to head the ball away after a cross into the penalty area, but instead he accidentally sends it inside the left post of his own goal. The goalkeeper was helpless.
74' We are about to witness a substitution. Pablo Torre (Mallorca) is replacing Sergi Darder.
74' The substitution is prepared. Mateu Morey Bauza (Mallorca) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Pablo Maffeo.
74' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) jumps highest to meet an accurate cross and heads the ball towards the net. His fine header whistles just inches wide of the right post.
73' That will be all from Johnny Cardoso who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid).
72' Diego Simeone has decided to make a change. Thiago Almada (Atl. Madrid) replaces Alexander Sorloth.
72' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) receives a pass and fires a shot in from long range, but it's blocked.

68' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) displays brilliant awareness inside the six-yard box and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the middle of the target, but Leo Roman keeps the ball out.
64' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) attempts to score from a mid-range free kick, but he curls his effort a few inches over the crossbar.
63' Mateo Joseph goes off the pitch and Jan Virgili (Mallorca) comes on.
63' Jagoba Arrasate decides to make a substitution. Antonio Sanchez will be replaced by Takuma Asano (Mallorca).
62' Tempers flare after a clattering challenge by Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid), who receives a yellow card from the referee. It could have been worse for him!
62' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) gets a precise pass from the edge of the box and swiftly strikes, but his shot misses to the left of the target.
59' Substitution. Alex Baena is replaced by Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid).
55' Jose Maria Gimenez (Atl. Madrid) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
51' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
50' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going into the roof of the net, but Leo Roman has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
48' The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid have been awarded a corner kick.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
41' Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

40' Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. The ball goes out of play. Mallorca are awarded a corner kick.
38' The goalkeeper is not tested by the free kick from the edge of the box by Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) as his effort only hit the wall.

36' Samu Costa (Mallorca) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Jose Sanchez blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Atl. Madrid earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
31' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Atl. Madrid comes to nothing.
31' An attempted cross from Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) is cleared. Atl. Madrid have a corner.
27' The shots on goal statistics – 4:0.
22' 1 - 0 Goal! Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) fires the rebound into the top left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:0.
22' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) unleashes a sweet first-timer from the edge of the box which is headed for the underside of the crossbar. The goalkeeper stops the shot with a quick save.
20' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner but it's cleared.

15' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball low towards the middle of the goal. However, he couldn't beat Leo Roman, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save.

15' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a low strike towards the middle of the goal. Leo Roman guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
14' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header high over the bar.
11' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
11' The resulting set piece from Atl. Madrid is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. The referee signals a corner kick to Atl. Madrid.
11' David Hancko (Atl. Madrid) times his run into the box beautifully and plants a good looking header at goal from the corner, but the ball flashes just wide of the left post.
10' Atl. Madrid force their opponents to concede a corner.

10' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The ball is out of play. Atl. Madrid win a corner kick.
8' Atl. Madrid have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
7' The ball is cleared after Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Atl. Madrid will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
3' Mateo Joseph plays a hopeful lofted pass into the box. Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) luckily gets his head to the ball and sends it narrowly wide of the right post from near the penalty spot.
2' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) takes the corner which is cleared.

2' Mallorca win a corner. Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
